Before we meet

Tell us about one problem

Five short questions, about five minutes. You get a short brief to send to your Microsoft contact, so your meeting starts with something to react to.

Question 1 of 5

What is the one task or problem you would most like help with?

What happens today, and what improvement would make this worth doing?

Which systems or files hold the information this work depends on?

If an AI helper for this task existed tomorrow, what are three things someone on your team would type into it?

What is the smallest first version that would still help? And are there rules it must follow?
